title: Great Archive of Memory
intro: A digital space for the historical heritage of East Kazakhstan Region: thematic collections of archival documents, biographies, a timeline of events and a historical map.

ways.label: Sections of the Archive of Memory

collections.title: Collections
collections.text: Documents and photographs grouped by theme

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.text: The region's history by decade and year

map.title: Historical map
map.text: Historic sites and places of events

directions.title: Thematic areas
directions.text: Eleven areas in which the archive gathers materials for this section. Areas that already have materials open them; the rest are in preparation.
directions.ust-kamenogorsk: History of Ust-Kamenogorsk and other settlements
directions.people: History of notable people of the region
directions.war: History of the Great Patriotic War
directions.periods: Development of the region in different historical periods

filters.label: Search collections and people
filters.q: Word in a title, description or name

collections.title: Thematic collections
collections.text: Selections of archival documents and photographs. Each document opens in the catalog with its archive code and fond details.
collections.empty: No collections have been published yet
collections.emptyText: The archive is preparing the first selections. You can already search documents in the electronic catalog.
collections.noneFoundText: Change the word or choose another theme and period.

people.title: Historical figures
people.text: Biographical notes on people connected with the region's history. Each note names the source of its information.
people.empty: No biographical notes have been published yet.

exhibitions.title: Online exhibitions
exhibitions.text: Archival documents and photographs arranged into a story: exhibits with captions and sources.

collection.editorial: The collection description and the notes on documents are editorial texts. Details of the documents themselves — code, date, author, fond — are given with each document and on its catalog card.
collection.none: This collection has no published documents yet.
collection.sourcesText: The documents of this collection are described in the catalog as part of the following fonds. Each link opens the fond description.

person.editorial: This note is an editorial text compiled from the sources named on this page.
person.noBio: The biographical note is in preparation.
person.noDocuments: No archival documents are linked to this page yet: the information follows the stated source and is not confirmed by archive documents.
person.sourcesText: The origin of the information is stated for every biographical note.

provenance.unconfirmedHint: The information follows the stated source. Archive documents that confirm it have not been linked to this entry yet.
